headline: Indonesian Parliamentary Session Sees Calls For Gibran To Resign
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Faces Resignation Demands In DPR
metaDescription: Calls for Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to resign have intensified during a plenary session at the Indonesian House of Representatives.
aiSummaryBullets: Legislators and protesters have publicly demanded the resignation of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka during and after a plenary session.
The Prosperous Justice Party suggested that a voluntary resignation would be preferable to a formal impeachment process in the legislature.
Political parties have varying positions, with some allowing members freedom of speech regarding controversies over Gibran's academic credentials.
aiContextParagraph: The political environment in Indonesia has shifted following developments at the House of Representatives (DPR) on November 10, 2026. During the opening of the second session of the 2026-2027 period, led by Speaker Puan Maharani, demonstrations and protest posters calling for the resignation of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka appeared at the parliamentary complex. Officials from the Golkar Party noted that any formal resignation must be processed through the DPR, while representatives from the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) stated that if a voluntary resignation does not occur, legislative proceedings regarding his removal could proceed. Concurrently, political organizations such as the Gerindra Party have indicated that their members are free to express individual opinions regarding ongoing concerns surrounding the Vice President's educational documentation. The situation remains a point of focus for parliamentary discourse and public protest activity.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score due to rapid, widespread coverage across multiple major Indonesian news outlets during a critical legislative session.
